title: Shorten a brief without losing consequential qualifications
prompt: Read benchmarks/sources/w1-pilot.md. Write a self-contained decision brief of at most 120 words. Preserve the measured result and qualifications needed to decide whether to deploy. State the proposed next step; do not invent a causal finding or approval.

acceptance_checks.description: States 20 internal cases and median response time changing from 12 to 9 seconds.
Preserves no control group and no measured customer outcomes; does not claim the intervention caused the change.
Preserves production deployment not approved and the proposed larger controlled trial.
At most 120 words, coherent and self-contained; no unsupported result or commitment.
